perf_1080 --prod --match-seeds 7,11,23 printed GATE FAIL, exit 1 (fw_CW1_r3v_perf.log/.json): seed 11 rot 5 'peak triangles 517852 > 500000 at 1621.8 s (1 s over)'. It is one frame: 398030 the frame before, crowd 29->52 and actors 184->223 as units arrive in view, 365162 at the next sample. The governor reacts to the last frame's count, so it cannot catch the first frame. A targeted rerun (--match-only --match-seeds 11 --match-rot 5) passed: 463k, game ended 1754.9 s against 1800 s, so the two runs did not play the same game (fw_CW1_r3v_seed11.log). So 1 fail in 2 on that seed. The triangle count is a hard check at any load, though load 264 and x4 may widen a frame's sim step; not proven either way. The rest passes: overlay_regress High and Low PASS (fw_CW1_r3v_overlay.log); value_probe, 6 map and tier runs with no FAIL line, BRIDGE env p99 and whole-frame p99 inside ruling 14, lowest flash FRAY low 2.03x (fw_CW1_r3v_value.json; exit code not captured, I killed the wrapper shell); typecheck clean; content:check 0 warnings.
items.fixHint: Choose one. (a) Estimate the frame's triangles from the crowd instance count in crowd.end() (src/render/renderer.ts:1149-1154, src/render/crowd.ts) and apply the ink cap or second step on that same frame, so an arriving wave cannot draw one uncapped frame. (b) Ask the lead for a ruling on a tolerance such as a single isolated frame, since the harness has none today. Do not relax the 500k bar here.
